newsitem.title: GREECE: BAKOYIANNI IS CANDIDATE FOR ND PARTY PRESIDENCY.
newsitem.headline: BAKOYIANNI IS CANDIDATE FOR ND PARTY PRESIDENCY.

text.p: Greek conservative New Democracy party deputy Dora Bakoyianni will be a candidate for the party presidency, she told reporters in a news conference.
"We must turn a page. Greece must look to the future with hope, there is a need for a new perspective. Many of us believed that New Democracy would have won the elections," said Bakoyianni.

Former conservative National Economy Minister Stefanos Manos has also declared his candidacy for the party leadership. Party heavyweights Yannis Varvitsiotis and George Souflias have not yet formally declared their candidacy.
There is talk that conservative deputy Costas Karamanlis will also be a candidate for the leadership of the conservative New Democracy party. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
